capabilities: create and edit mind maps on an infinite canvas
render any Markdown note's nested lists as a mind map
edit nodes with keyboard shortcuts (Tab, Enter, Delete, F2)
drag nodes freely with connectors following
store mind maps as plain-text nested Markdown lists
extras: README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; a Chinese-language section repeats the usage and build instructions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or edit a note's nested list structure as a visual mind map.
summary: Mind map editor that renders nested Markdown lists as a zoomable, draggable tree on an infinite canvas.
